pattern: CADRE: one Opus director over Sonnet specialists. Tool isolation is declared here and enforced by scripts/validate.py against .claude/agents/*.md.

agents.name: stagehand-director
agents.role: Runs the eight moves, delegates each to a specialist, and writes the manifest line.

agents.name: essence-reader
agents.role: Reads the brief and returns five essence words and the dominant data shape. Never opens the codex.

agents.name: theme-scout
agents.role: Runs the fit test, proposes the triptych with at most one theme-led concept, and checks the ledger.

agents.name: theme-stylist
agents.role: Applies the dial, fills S1 to S5 from the card, and wires tokens and fonts into the build.

agents.name: homage-auditor
agents.role: Grades blind: runs the swap test and the safety table against the built output, with no write tools and no access to the stylist's rationale.

agents.name: reel-engineer
agents.role: Adds or changes reel scenes, keeps the scene API and the data beat grammar, and rebuilds the reel.

agents.name: card-author
agents.role: Writes a new theme card into canon (bench graduation), with every field, a contrast check and a homage review.
